tasks.title: Make source registration and refresh executable
tasks.commit: fix(api): make source refresh configuration executable
acceptance: Source configuration validates adapter, terms and network mode before enabling
Refresh resolves adapters without unbound variables and records actionable source errors
A source with no adapter or zero jobs cannot silently report a healthy ingestion
Backend source and refresh regression tests pass

tasks.title: Normalize job description and application links
tasks.commit: fix(api): normalize job source links
acceptance: Relative links resolve correctly with and without trailing slash
Description and application URLs remain distinct when supplied
Invalid or missing links produce source-level errors with fixture coverage

tasks.title: Add executable source configuration and diagnostics to dashboard
tasks.commit: feat(web): add source configuration diagnostics
acceptance: UI configures adapter, terms acknowledgement and network/fixture mode
Source list exposes last run status and actionable errors
Source creation rejects incomplete runnable configuration

tasks.title: Persist restrictions and preference controls
tasks.commit: fix(web): persist profile restrictions and preferences
acceptance: Restriction controls are controlled state and load from persisted preferences
Reloading the profile preserves every restriction and weight
HTTP and frontend persistence tests pass

tasks.title: Add source and preference end-to-end regression coverage
tasks.commit: test(regression): cover source ingestion and preference persistence
acceptance: Fixture source reaches ingestion and exposes failures
Relative links are verified in dashboard detail flow
Restrictions survive API save and browser reload

tasks.title: Resolve legacy source adapters by provider and URL
tasks.commit: fix(api): resolve legacy source adapters
acceptance: API/feed sources resolve through the canonical kind mapping
Greenhouse and Lever legacy names or URLs resolve to their adapters
Unknown career pages remain explicitly unsupported
Regression tests cover legacy resolution without changing terms acceptance

tasks.title: Add validated Greenhouse and Lever JSON job feeds
tasks.commit: feat(api): support validated ats job feeds
acceptance: Greenhouse jobs API records normalize title, company, description and actionable absolute URL
Lever postings API records normalize title, location, description and distinct hosted/application URLs
Malformed or missing ATS links are rejected without example.com fallbacks
Connector regression tests pass for both feed shapes

tasks.title: Harden ATS feed metadata and company labeling
tasks.commit: fix(api): harden ats feed normalization
acceptance: Greenhouse metadata arrays do not discard valid jobs or fail the source
Configured company labels are applied when a provider omits company
Existing URL validation and connector regression tests remain green

tasks.title: Allow explicit source terms acceptance when enabling
tasks.commit: fix(web): explain and confirm source activation
acceptance: Enabling a source with unaccepted terms asks for explicit confirmation and sends terms_accepted=true
Cancelling confirmation leaves the source paused without an API request
API validation errors are shown with an actionable message
Frontend regression tests and pnpm build pass

tasks.title: Add integrated source activation dialog
tasks.commit: fix(web): add source terms activation dialog
acceptance: Activation opens an in-panel dialog with source name, terms link and required checkbox
Cancel closes the dialog without a PATCH and activation remains paused
Confirm sends terms_accepted=true only after checkbox acceptance
Dialog has accessible labeling, focus-visible controls and inline errors
Frontend tests, typecheck and production build pass

tasks.title: Hide stale run errors for paused sources
tasks.commit: fix(web): distinguish paused sources from stale runs
acceptance: Paused sources display Pausada regardless of historical run status
Historical source errors are not shown as current errors while paused
Enabled sources retain their latest run status and error details
Frontend regression tests, typecheck and build pass

tasks.title: Evaluate jobs during manual refresh
tasks.commit: fix(api): calculate compatibility during refresh
acceptance: Manual refresh evaluates discovered jobs against the current profile
Job list and detail responses expose persisted compatibility scores
Missing profile or scoring failures are reported without rolling back ingestion
Backend refresh and matching regression tests pass

tasks.title: Ignore Remote OK API legal metadata records
tasks.commit: fix(api): ignore remote ok legal metadata
acceptance: Remote OK legal metadata does not create an invalid-job source error
Valid Remote OK jobs remain ingestible with description and application links
Generic feeds still report malformed job records as partial
Connector and related backend tests pass

tasks.title: Add validated Mexico job sources
tasks.commit: feat(api): add validated mexico job sources
acceptance: Mexican company boards expose valid description and application URLs
Ashby job board fields are normalized without example.com fallbacks
Location classification recognizes Mexico and Guadalajara variants
Connector and source regression tests pass

tasks.title: Prepare GitHub-ready project README
tasks.commit: docs(repo): prepare github project documentation
acceptance: README documents purpose, AI-assisted development, architecture and stack
Docker, local development, Notion, Ollama, sources, cron and tests are documented
GitHub publication and security guidance are included
Commands and repository links are consistent with the current project
